items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Buster Bailey, Herman Autrey, and Vic Dickenson.

ctx.x: And they worked Columbus, Ohio, Cleveland, Detroit, and I'm trying -- I think yes, they worked Chicago. And they had a good band. Vic Dickenson, and Red, and _____ was on drum. They -- I wasn't there then.
Who was on trumpet before you were there?
